what_it_does: AQB8 accelerates ray tracing (a rendering technique that simulates light bouncing through a scene) by compressing the 3D scene hierarchy using 8-bit integers instead of 32-bit floating-point numbers. Rather than decompress back to floating-point for intersection tests (checking if a ray hits an object), AQB8 performs intersection calculations directly on 8-bit integers using efficient hardware. A hierarchical error-compensation mechanism ensures no rays are wrongly classified as missing objects.
